paraphrase: OPEN analyst generalization of ST I q.7 a.1 co.: every real determination of a being that is no recipient is a pure perfection. The passage says a form is determined and has its amplitude contracted by the matter that receives it (that reception is the only source of limitation is the analyst's; q.7 a.2 contracts a subsistent created form's esse without matter), and that an undetermined form has the character of the perfect; extending this from form and esse to every real determination, and holding that the other non-pure determinations of DEF-PURE-PERFECTION (individuating principles, potencies, privations) occur only in recipients, is the analyst's.
